<?php
class ScopeBase236 { public function __invoke($value) { echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class Scope236 extends ScopeBase236 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $owner->MiSsInG((new self)(true)); $owner->MiSsInG((new parent)(true)); $owner->MiSsInG(first:(new static)(true)); } } class ScopeChild236 extends Scope236 { public function __invoke($value) { echo "CHILD/",static::class,";"; return $value; } }
class ScopeMagic236 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic236; ScopeChild236::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift236() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class PacketBase236 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->saved = $value; echo "CTOR;"; } public function __invoke($first,$ignored) { echo "INVOKE;"; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope236 extends PacketBase236 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((new static(7))(true,shift236())); } } class PacketChild236 extends PacketScope236 {}
class Owner236 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new Owner236; $child = PacketChild236::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketChild236 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class StopBase236 { public function __invoke() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "INVOKE;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class StopScope236 extends StopBase236 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((new parent)(),later236()); } } class StopChild236 extends StopScope236 {}
function later236() { echo "LATER;"; return 1; } class FailedMagic236 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic236; $result = 0; try { $result = StopChild236::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";
